ratification.ratified_by: user delegation (assistant-authored); the pinned 1.5B batch-1 proposal was incomplete (no per-axis vocabularies), so the ontology below carries the provisional M165 schema with the batch-2 corrections applied

latent.label_cardinality.rule: inclusive upper bounds; above the top closed bin maps to the open bin and is logged

normalisation_rules: categorical attributes must be registered tokens; anything else maps to <oov> and the event is logged (no-refusal)
continuous attributes quantise into the registered bins above
the canonical serialisation uses the frozen axis order and no alphabetic re-sort; the axis order is part of the schema
payload hashes cover content only; no wall-clock fields

similarity_positive_controls.correction_note: the LLM draft marked CIFAR-10 + Mackey-Glass as known_similar; it is registered here as known_dissimilar (I3: proposals are hypotheses, not labels)

provenance.grounded_in: the sealed v16-v23 measurements (DomainNet, CIFAR-10, M147/M157 temporal axes), the M164/M164b/M164c reference ledgers, and the v24 section 3 schema
provenance.next_version_trigger: M169's fingerprint gates (G2 ordering) fail on this control set
